belt_extra.message: belt constraints only accept pulley_radius_a and pulley_radius_b

belt_missing.message: belt constraints require pulley_radius_a and pulley_radius_b

fixed_drive.message: fixed constraints do not accept drive scalars

fixed_limit.message: fixed constraints do not accept scalar limits

gear_drive.message: gear constraints do not accept drive scalars

gear_extra.message: gear constraints only accept pitch_radius_a and pitch_radius_b

gear_missing.message: gear constraints require pitch_radius_a and pitch_radius_b

prismatic_angle.message: prismatic constraints only accept distance scalars

prismatic_radius.message: prismatic constraints do not accept coupling radii or phase_offset

revolute_distance.message: revolute constraints only accept angle scalars

same_ref.message: constraint cannot connect the same connector ref twice

unknown_kind.message: constraint_kind must be fixed, revolute, prismatic, gear, belt, or rack_pinion
